The '''Tube-Launched Grapple''' was a one-shot [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] launcher produced by [[Line Master]]. The device was a hollow cylinder forty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long with a ten centimeter diameter. It had a pop up targeting sight, retractable hand grip with braking controls, and one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of [[Ultra-light micro-woven synthecord|ultralight micro-woven synthecord]]. The cable was attached to a flat, flexible disk covered in a strong bonding agent which adhered to any surface.
